title: Cucamelon - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Mini Melons - Tastes Amazing
description:
Grow Your Own Delicious Miniature Melons - Easy & Productive!


KEY FEATURES
• Delicious cucumber-lime flavour, perfect for snacking and salads
• High-yielding and easy to grow, even for beginners
• Vigorous climbing habit, ideal for vertical gardening
• Unique miniature watermelon appearance adds novelty to your garden
• Resistant to many common cucumber diseases


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Melothria scabra
Colour: Green with dark stripes (fruit)
Season: Summer to early autumn (fruiting)
Growth Habit: Climbing
Flavour: Crisp, refreshing, with a distinct cucumber and lime taste
Time to Harvest: 60-70 days from planting


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Well-drained, fertile soil
Watering: Regular, consistent watering, especially during dry spells and fruiting
Spacing: 30-45 cm apart, with support for climbing
Height: 1.5-2.5 metres (if supported)
Spread: 0.5-1 metre (if allowed to trail)
Hardiness: UK H1C (Frost Tender, grow as annual)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Acclimatise young plants gradually before planting outdoors after the last frost.
• Provide a sturdy support structure (trellis, cane) for the vines to climb.
• Water regularly, especially once fruits begin to form, keeping the soil consistently moist but not waterlogged.
• Feed with a balanced liquid fertiliser every 2-3 weeks once flowering begins.
• Harvest fruits when they are about grape-sized and firm to the touch for the best flavour.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
